meta.project: Peta Tematik Interaktif — Kabupaten Padang Pariaman

product_overview: Peta Tematik Interaktif Kabupaten Padang Pariaman adalah aplikasi web berbasis peta yang menampilkan data infrastruktur, statistik wilayah, dan informasi administrasi area untuk publik. Admin panel menyediakan login aman serta pengelolaan kategori, infrastruktur, statistik, dan upload file pendukung.
core_goals: Menyajikan peta interaktif Kabupaten Padang Pariaman untuk warga dan pengunjung umum
Memungkinkan filter dan pencarian data infrastruktur berdasarkan kategori dan wilayah
Menyediakan statistik wilayah yang dapat dipantau dan diperbarui oleh admin
Mendukung pengelolaan data melalui panel admin dengan autentikasi JWT
Menyediakan upload file/foto untuk mendukung data infrastruktur
Menjaga konsistensi data kategori, infrastruktur, statistik, dan wilayah melalui API terstruktur

features.name: Autentikasi Admin
features.description: Admin dapat masuk ke panel pengelolaan menggunakan kredensial yang valid dan menerima token JWT untuk akses protected endpoint.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with valid username and password -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> Use token to access protected admin endpoints such as POST /api/kategori -> Receive 200 or 201 confirming authenticated access
POST /api/auth/login with invalid credentials -> Receive 401 with error message -> Admin remains unauthenticated and protected endpoints continue to reject requests with missing/invalid token

features.name: Kategori Infrastruktur
features.description: Admin dan publik dapat melihat daftar kategori infrastruktur, sementara admin dapat membuat, mengubah, dan menghapus kategori melalui endpoint protected.
user_flows: GET /api/kategori -> Receive 200 with list of categories for public filter chips -> Admin uses the same category data to populate category management UI
POST /api/kategori with valid JWT and category payload -> Receive 201 or 200 with created category -> GET /api/kategori -> Receive updated category list
POST /api/kategori without JWT -> Receive 401 unauthorized -> Category is not created
PUT /api/kategori/:id with valid JWT and updated fields -> Receive 200 with updated category -> GET /api/kategori -> Receive updated values
DELETE /api/kategori/:id with valid JWT for a category that is not in use -> Receive 200 or 204 confirming deletion -> GET /api/kategori -> Receive category removed
DELETE /api/kategori/:id for a category still referenced by infrastructure data -> Receive error response such as 400 or 409 -> Category remains available

features.name: Infrastruktur
features.description: Public users can browse infrastructure records, while admins can create, update, delete, and import/export infrastructure data to power the map and search experience.
user_flows: GET /api/infrastruktur -> Receive 200 with paginated infrastructure list -> Public map renders markers and popup content from returned data
GET /api/infrastruktur?search=nama&kategori=restoran&kdkec=130501 -> Receive 200 with filtered infrastructure results -> User narrows map and search results to matching items
POST /api/infrastruktur with valid JWT and complete infrastructure payload -> Receive 201 or 200 with created record -> GET /api/infrastruktur -> Receive updated list including the new infrastructure
POST /api/infrastruktur without JWT -> Receive 401 unauthorized -> Infrastructure record is not created
PUT /api/infrastruktur/:id with valid JWT and edited location/category data -> Receive 200 with updated infrastructure -> GET /api/infrastruktur -> Receive updated marker and popup data
DELETE /api/infrastruktur/:id with valid JWT -> Receive 200 or 204 confirming deletion -> GET /api/infrastruktur -> Receive record removed from list
PUT /api/infrastruktur/:id with invalid coordinates or missing required fields -> Receive 400 validation error -> Existing infrastructure data remains unchanged

features.name: Statistik
features.description: Public users can view regional statistics, and admins can create or maintain statistic entries that drive the dashboard and public charts.
user_flows: GET /api/statistik -> Receive 200 with statistics list -> Public statistics panel and charts render indicator data
GET /api/statistik?kdkab=1305&kdkec=130501&tahun=2026 -> Receive 200 with filtered statistics -> Charts update to reflect the selected region and year
POST /api/statistik with valid JWT and statistic payload -> Receive 201 or 200 with created statistic entry -> GET /api/statistik -> Receive updated statistics list
POST /api/statistik without JWT -> Receive 401 unauthorized -> Statistic entry is not created
POST /api/statistik with missing required fields such as indikator or nilai -> Receive 400 validation error -> No statistic is persisted

features.name: Wilayah
features.description: Public users can retrieve administrative area data to drive cascading wilayah filters for kecamatan, nagari, and korong.
user_flows: GET /api/wilayah/kecamatan -> Receive 200 with kecamatan list -> User selects a kecamatan for the next filter level
GET /api/wilayah/nagari?kdkec=130501 -> Receive 200 with nagari list for the selected kecamatan -> User continues cascade filtering
GET /api/wilayah/korong?kddesa=1305010001 -> Receive 200 with korong list for the selected nagari -> User completes wilayah selection
GET /api/wilayah/nagari without required kdkec query -> Receive 400 or empty result depending on server validation -> User is prompted to choose a kecamatan first

features.name: Upload File/Foto
features.description: Admin can upload photos or other supported files for infrastructure records, with server-side validation for authentication, file type, and size.
user_flows: POST /api/upload with valid JWT and a supported file -> Receive 200 with uploaded file path or metadata -> Admin attaches returned file reference to infrastructure data
POST /api/upload with a file larger than the allowed size or unsupported type -> Receive 400 validation error -> File is rejected and not stored
POST /api/upload without JWT -> Receive 401 unauthorized -> Upload is denied
